text:
tess: heads-up — onboarding boreal13b-int4 to a40-canary. hit two transient alloc failures during a rapid chat ramp. short log below.

tess: looks like kv_cache freelist fragmentation, compactor wakes and frees small chunks, but gen worker still hits reserve failures.

omar: can you paste the canary runtime config? batch + max_new_tokens + prefetch?

tess: initial canary config:
```json
{"model":"boreal13b-int4","batch_size":14,"max_new_tokens":512,"prefetch":true,"slab_cushion_pct":6}
```

felix: 14+512+prefetch on a40 during warm ramp is a frag hotspot. quick mitigations: batch=6, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=false, slot_compactor=aggressive, slab_cushion_pct=10. also set kv_trim_threshold=0.6.

tess: applied patch and started a 3k synthetic run. patch snippet:```yaml
runtime:
  batching: { default_batch_size: 6 }
  generation: { max_new_tokens_default: 256 }
  prefetch_kv: false
  mem: { slab_cushion_pct: 10, slot_compactor: aggressive }
  kv: { kv_trim_threshold: 0.6 }
```

ops-bot: canary rollout requested -> pool-a40-canary (4 hosts) by tess

felix: add kv_max_entries cap (2048) for canary. long prefixes can hog transient memory.

tess: added kv_max_entries=2048. results: 3k synthetic reqs, OOMs=0, p99 gen latency +28ms, throughput -11%. metrics: "OOMs:0 | p99: 360ms | avg:138ms"

omar: good stability trade. queue a 200-prompt eval at the reduced max_new_tokens to check for quality regressions.

qa-bot: eval started (200 prompts). comparing int4->fp16 semantics and formatting.

tess: initial eval pass: embedding-sim median=0.989, 2/200 outliers with minor punctuation/whitespace diffs. no semantic regressions.

felix: follow-ups: 1) add per-model conservative defaults into model-catalog (based on model_size, quant, gpu_family), 2) implement a frag-smoke preflight that ramps traffic 0->25->60% and records alloc_fail counts, 3) make prefetch opt-in for canary.

omar: I'll file infra ticket for defaults + frag-smoke. also add a checklist item: when reducing max_new_tokens, always run the 200-prompt eval.

tess: copying small error excerpt to the triage notes:```
[2026-07-09T10:14:02Z] ERROR kv_alloc failed size=96MB reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-07-09T10:14:02Z] WARN slot_compactor: pass freed=26MB duration_ms=51
[2026-07-09T10:14:03Z] ERROR gen_worker: reserve failed for 48MB -> allocation failed
```

felix: nice work. leave canary open 8h and monitor tail latencies. tagging this thread for the onboarding playbook update. :white_check_mark:
